intro.title: Building Permits & Addressing
intro.description: The Hart County Building Permitting Office oversees building and mobile home permits within the unincorporated areas of Hart County and works with E-911 to ensure residences and commercial buildings are properly addressed.

paragraphs: In accordance with O.C.G.A. 48-5-264.1, Hart County Appraisal Staff may visit property to review parcel information related to an appeal, return, new construction or additions, parcel review, or conservation use application.
Field appraisers will have photo identification and will be driving a marked County vehicle.
public_notice.important: Every parcel in Hart County will be re-evaluated each year.

overview: Building permits are governed by County Ordinance Chapter 18, and mobile home permits are governed by County Ordinance Chapter 50.
All permit applicants must read, understand, and follow the requirements established in the Hart County Code of Ordinances.
residential_requirements: Inspections are required for all new residential construction. Permit fees for new residential construction are assessed at $0.20 per heated square foot and $0.10 per unheated square foot, plus $100.00 per trade.
All other construction, renovations, and outbuildings are permitted as usual. Other permits remain $25.00 unless the value added or cost of construction is less than $2,500.

Plans and applications are reviewed by Bureau Veritas, and inspections are scheduled through Bureau Veritas. Questions concerning building codes, plan reviews, or inspections should be directed to Bureau Veritas.

Tiny houses, including converted storage buildings or shipping containers, are not allowed. Permitted residential structures are single-family or multi-family stick-built buildings or approved pre-built mobile homes as defined by County ordinances and approved by the State Fire Marshal.
jurisdiction: Hart County issues permits only for the unincorporated areas of Hart County.
If the property is inside the City of Hartwell, you must contact the City Building Inspector. The Hart County Permit Office does not issue permits for the City of Hartwell.
A Certification of Exemption from the City of Hartwell is required when a project area is adjacent to the Hartwell city limits.
